g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access Requests that name a resource by id do not check that the caller owns it. At server.ts:450, PUT /api/Addresss/:id runs only appendUserId and then falls through to the generic finale Address resource. An authenticated user can overwrite any other user's delivery address by id. appendUserId only requires a token that is present in the in-memory token map. At routes/coupon.ts:18, an authenticated customer calls PUT /rest/basket/<victim id>/coupon/<code>. applyCoupon loads the basket by id with findByPk and overwrites its coupon, so the attacker can tamper with another user's basket discount. isAuthorized on /rest/basket requires a valid token, but there is no owner check. The finding holds 3 places, more than the locations cited here. C-03 · Juice Shop Express API No account required Authorization is implemented route by route (W-005) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Input into Server Interpreters I send GET /rest/products/search?q=qwert')) UNION SELECT id,email,password,'4','5','6','7','8','9' FROM Users-- with no login. C-03 · Juice Shop Express API No account required Database access relies on concatenated queries (W-002) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication I find a target's email address that is linked to Google sign-in, for example from reviews or other public profile data. C-08 · Angular Client Application No account required No weakness linked in the register Any OAuth-linked account, including privileged ones, can be fully taken over by anyone who knows its email. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Crafted input runs code on the server I register and log in, then POST /profile with username=#{global.process.mainModule.require('child_process').execSync('id').toString()}. C-03 · Juice Shop Express API No account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-001) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data

g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets At routes/dataErasure.ts:104 a logged-in user posts to /dataerasure with a layout value. req.body is spread into the render options, so the view engine loads the file the user names as the layout, and the first 100 characters of the rendered file come back in the response. The scanner part classes this as path traversal from request input: a path with ../ can read arbitrary files such as /etc/passwd, source code or secrets, or write outside the intended root. The verification part shows only the layout file being read. The controls are a deny-list that blocks only three path substrings (line 105) and a session cookie requirement (line 76). C-03 · Juice Shop Express API No account required Input handling lacks enforced boundary validation (W-004) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Scripts into Victim Browsers An attacker sends a victim a link to /#/search?q=<iframe src="javascript:alert(document.cookie)">. filterTable reads q, marks it as trusted HTML and binds it to [innerHTML]. The script runs in the app origin and can read the JWT from localStorage. C-08 · Angular Client Application No account required; Victim interaction required Frontend rendering lacks enforced output encoding (W-007) Technical consequence not established. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Supply-Chain / Build Attacker 1 role; access details in Identified Actors Compromise the Build or Its Inputs Several workflows reference actions by tag or branch, and a tag or branch can be moved, so a compromised publisher can inject code into a reference that is already in use. At .github/workflows/ci.yml:188, coverallsapp/github-action@v2 runs in the coverage-report job on push to juice-shop. If an attacker compromises that repository or moves the v2 tag, the code receives GITHUB_TOKEN. Because ci.yml has no permissions block, the token has the repository-default scope and can be used to tamper with repository contents or releases. Most other actions in ci.yml are pinned to full commit SHAs. At .github/workflows/image_actions.yml:33, calibreapp/image-actions is referenced by @main. Any new commit to that third-party branch runs immediately on push to master or develop with GITHUB_TOKEN, and can commit or open PRs with altered content. That workflow also uses tag-only refs for actions/checkout@v6 and peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8. A job condition limits runs to the upstream repository and same-repo PR heads. At .github/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml:23, the github/codeql-action init, autobuild and analyze steps use @v3. If that tag is moved, the code runs with security-events: write and can suppress or forge code-scanning results. That workflow has a least-privilege permissions block, and the action is GitHub first-party. C-02 · CI/CD Pipeline Build or dependency access required Build pipeline trusts mutable third-party references (W-042) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data
